column3: “Seven and seven pipes” is rendered “seven spouts belonging to each of the lamps”; NASB adds “each.” The meaning of “seven and seven” is uncertain.
“Who are you” is rendered “What are you”; NASB supplies “you will become” and renders “level ground” as “a plain.”
“The stone, the tin” is rendered “the plumb line”; NASB makes “these seven” the subject of “will be glad,” and renders “roving about” as “range to and fro.”
“Clusters” is rendered “olive branches”; “the gold” is rendered “the golden oil,” and “at the hand of” “beside.”
“He said to me” is rendered “he answered me.”
“The two sons of the fresh oil” is rendered “the two anointed ones”; “stand at” is rendered “standing by.”
